beats.subline: Monday, November 9, 2026 close — a sharp rally as chip stocks rebounded and the Dow surged over 1,100 points, even as Nvidia slid on news of a board investigation into CEO Jensen Huang.
beats.body: Stocks bounced hard from last week's AI-spending selloff as chip and industrial names rallied; Nvidia fell early after its board opened an investigation tied to reports CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a suspected Chinese intelligence operative, but the stock pared losses as the broader market surged. Oil slid on hopes for progress in US-Iran talks, and Anthropic launched its IPO roadshow the same day.

beats.headline: Trump says new large-scale strikes on Iran aren't needed for now
beats.body: President Trump told reporters Monday he sees little need for an extensive new attack on Iran given progress in negotiations, while saying Iran's military is finished as a fighting force; Defense Secretary Hegseth said US forces remain ready to act if talks break down.

beats.headline: Taiwan reports fresh PLA aircraft and naval activity near its territory
beats.body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported four PLA aircraft sorties, six PLA Navy vessels and two China Coast Guard ships operating near the island over a recent 24-hour period, continuing a pattern of near-daily Chinese military activity around Taiwan this month.

beats.headline: Anthropic sets IPO price range, targets Nasdaq debut November 19
beats.body: Anthropic launched its IPO roadshow and set a price range of $70 to $78 a share for its Class A stock, which it plans to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker 'ANT'; the offering could value the Claude maker at up to roughly $1 trillion, with trading expected to start November 19.

beats.headline: Bears' thin secondary takes more hits as Stevenson, Gordon exit Sunday's game
beats.body: Cornerback Tyrique Stevenson suffered a thumb injury and Kyler Gordon briefly left with an arm injury during Sunday night's game against Tampa Bay, further straining a Bears secondary already missing rookie Malik Muhammad, who sat out with a toe injury; Gordon returned to the game and said afterward he expects to be fine.
